title: Push-forward by dilations x ↦ λx (scaling of currents, step E0)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ there is an operation dil assigning to every degree k ∈ ℕ, real λ and current X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (domain univ) a current dil_k(λ, X) ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) such that for every k and every λ > 0: (1) dil_k(λ, X − Y) = dil_k(λ, X) − dil_k(λ, Y) for all X, Y; (2) dil_k(λ⁻¹, dil_k(λ, X)) = X; (3) M(dil_k(λ, X)) = λ^k M(X) (in [0, ∞], factor ENNReal.ofReal (λ^k)); (4) spt dil_k(λ, X) = {λx : x ∈ spt X}; (5) dil_k(λ, X) is integer multiplicity whenever X is (every degree k, including 0); (6) ∂dil_{k+1}(λ, X) = dil_k(λ, ∂X) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ dil : ∀ k : ℕ, ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, ∀ (k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam (X - Y) = dil k lam X - dil k lam Y) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam⁻¹ (dil k lam X) = X) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (dil k lam X).mass = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ k) * X.mass) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (dil k lam X).support = (fun x => lam • x) '' X.support) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (dil k lam X)) ∧ ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), (dil (k + 1) lam X).boundary = dil k lam X.boundary
